artifact_observations.reasoning: The reflection of the woman's face is unusually sharp and undistorted given the curved, complex geometry of the iron's surface. Real-world reflections on such surfaces would typically show significant warping or stretching. This suggests potential AI generation artifacts where the reflection was 'pasted' or rendered without accurate optical distortion.

The internal mechanism visible through the transparent casing appears somewhat nonsensical or fused. The central dial lacks clear connection points or logical mechanical structure, appearing more like a decorative graphic than a functional part.
Standard depth-of-field blur, but some edges in the background (top right) show slight smearing inconsistent with natural lens bokeh.

To verify the integrity of the transparent casing and ensure no floating parts or boundary bleeding between the internal components and the shell.

focus_areas: Optical correctness of the reflection on the curved transparent surface
Structural logic of internal components visible through the casing
Boundary definition between the iron and the background

custom_prompts_for_reflector: Pay close attention to the reflection of the person on the iron. In real photography, reflections on curved, transparent/plastic surfaces are heavily distorted. If the reflection remains too recognizable or undistorted, it is a strong indicator of AI generation. Also, examine the 'dial' in the center; does it look like a functional mechanical part or a painted-on graphic? Check if the hand gripping the handle has anatomical correctness, particularly finger placement and pressure deformation on the plastic.
